profile.name: N8700系列可编程直流电源
profile.name_en: N8700 Series Programmable DC Power Supply
profile.description: N8700系列是一类可编程直流电源，用于为实验装置、电子模块或测试样品提供稳定的直流电压和电流输出，并支持输出开关、前面板锁定以及电压、电流、功率测量。在实验室和自动化测试中，常用于器件供电、负载测试和系统集成供电。
profile.description_en: The N8700 series is a programmable DC power supply used to provide stable DC voltage and current to experimental setups, electronic modules, or test samples. It supports output on/off control, front-panel lockout, and measurement of voltage, current, and power. In laboratories and automated test systems, it is commonly used for DUT powering, load testing, and integrated system power delivery.
